subject: Avatech MAP: evaluation materials handshake & takedown
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Eli Turner <eli@avatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Avatech MAP: evaluation materials handshake & takedown

Eli —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to formalize a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we can get a scoped evaluation across Avatech's core flows. Key ask from our side: a guarded set of your prompt pack and ~500–1,000 representative test cases so we can run throughput/latency and quality regression checks in an isolated sandbox.

High-level constraints we propose:
- Sandbox access for Redwood limited to a dedicated, ephemeral bucket with access keys that expire after the evaluation window.
- No redistribution of assets outside of the sandbox; derivative model weights not allowed.
- Audit logs retained for 90 days; customer may request deletion earlier.
- Prompt/testcase subset for POC (500 items) — full pack available post-contract.

I'm attaching a short Redwood_MPA_template.pdf that lays out milestones, acceptance gates, and a takedown procedure. If this looks sane, can you share the prompt pack and a small sample of testcases so our team can size integration?

Proposed MAP timeline (draft):
- Week 0: exchange sample artifacts and sign MAP
- Week 1: Redwood ingest + sandbox setup
- Week 2–3: evaluation runs, metric collection
- Week 4: review results + decision point / close

If procurement/legal need a specific SOW or data-handling language, loop them in and we'll adapt.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_MPA_template.pdf (doc, 28 KB)
From: Eli Turner <eli@avatech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@avatech.com>, Legal <legal@avatech.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Avatech MAP: evaluation materials handshake & takedown

Karthik —

Appreciate the clear outline. Procurement and legal are looped in. We can provide a prompt pack and a CSV of 1,200 test cases; to speed the POC we'll push a 500-row sample first. Attaching the pack here for your engineers to review.

A few constraints from our side:
- We need an explicit non-use clause for indexing and any model fine-tuning using the raw prompts.
- Access tokens should be IP-restricted to Redwood's sandbox hosts.
- Avatech requires destructive takedown confirmation (signed) once evaluation ends.

I'll share the sample this afternoon. If you can provide a signed MAP or DocuSign with the takedown clause, we can authorize procurement to deliver the full pack.

Thanks —
Eli Turner
Product Lead, Avatech
eli@avatech.com

Attachments: avatech_promptpack_v2.zip (archive, 9.8 MB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Avatech MAP: evaluation materials handshake & takedown

Karthik / Olga —

Quick read of the Avatech prompt pack (thanks Eli). Notes and recommended controls for the sandbox ingestion:

1) Sampleing & hashing
- We should accept the 500-row CSV sample (iav_testcases_sample.csv) and compute content hashes on ingest. Store only hashed IDs in our audit ledger; redact raw prompts from persistent logs.

2) Access & runtime constraints
- Deploy the evaluation on a dedicated sandbox cluster (non-shared GPUs) with ephemeral API keys that expire 30 days after end of active evaluation.
- Apply IP allowlist matching Avatech's provided CIDR blocks.

3) Non-use & retention
- Add explicit MAP language: Redwood will not use raw prompts or testcases to improve models outside of this contracted evaluation. Any telemetry used for model improvement must be mutually agreed and opt-in.
- Auto-delete raw artifacts 14 days after close unless Avatech requests retention for debugging (maximum 90 days).

4) Audit & takedown
- Provide signed takedown confirmation template (short form) that Avatech signs when they request deletion.

5) Timeline suggestion (more conservative):
- Day 0 (sample exchange) — 500 sample rows + MAP signature
- Day 3–7 — sandbox ingest and smoke tests
- Day 8–21 — scheduled evaluation runs and metric collection windows (3 runs)
- Day 22 — results review and close / next steps

If you want, I can draft MAP edits and the takedown confirmation template for Karthik to send. Also note: engineering will want the sample in CSV + a short schema doc describing any placeholder tokens.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior PM, Customer Evals — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Eli Turner <eli@avatech.com>, Procurement <procurement@avatech.com>, Legal <legal@avatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Sep 2025 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Final MAP & DocuSign: Avatech evaluation window and takedown template

Eli / team —

Thanks for the prompt pack — team has what it needs to start sizing. Per Marissa's recommendations I've baked the non-use and retention language into a one-page MAP (attached: MAP_AvaTech_v1.docx) and included a short takedown confirmation template. Key changes from your draft:
- Raw prompts/testcases will be kept only in the sandbox; we will record SHA256 hashes for audit.
- Raw artifacts auto-deleted 14 days after signed takedown; optional retention up to 90 days only with written approval.
- No indexing or model training permitted on raw artifacts; any usage beyond evaluation requires written opt-in.

Please review and sign here: https://secure.docusign.com/doc/ABCD-AVT-MAP. Once signed, procurement can proceed to transfer the full prompt pack.

Proposed final close timeline:
- 21 Sep: MAP signed and keys exchanged
- 22–25 Sep: sandbox ingest + smoke tests
- 26 Sep–10 Oct: evaluation window (two-week runs + metrics)
- 13 Oct: results review and closure / expansion discussion

Deal id: RDW-AVT-2025-092. Let me know if procurement/legal want any redlines — we can turn them around quickly.

Regards,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: MAP_AvaTech_v1.docx (docx, 16 KB)
From: Eli Turner <eli@avatech.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@avatech.com>, Legal <legal@avatech.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Sep 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Final MAP & DocuSign: Avatech evaluation window and takedown template

Karthik —

We reviewed the MAP and the takedown language looks good to Avatech legal. Procurement has one ask: can we shift the start of the evaluation window two weeks later to accommodate a scheduled audit on our side? If that works for Redwood, we'll sign the DocuSign this afternoon and queue the data transfer.

Eli Turner
Product Lead, Avatech
eli@avatech.com
